method: Read-only source, saved artifacts and Cargo cache review; read-only GitHub Actions query; no builds, examples, tests, benchmarks, corpus scans, RPCs or node operations.

ci.verification: Read from gh run list during this review. The workflow does not invoke the Python executable-regression runner.

saved_regression.qualification: The reported 84/84 rerun is not independently archived as new evidence here. The existing log still reports cd3cb45+dirty, and the source has no h=0 or incremental-build test. No additional broad rerun requested solely for this distinction.

accepted: Both earlier unchecked height subtractions now use checked_sub; the existing boundary guard rejects a parent-before-genesis setup. Close the source defect.
Cargo records watches for .git/HEAD and refs/heads/main. Accept tracking of committed tip changes in this normal checkout.
qualifications: Newly printed dd69355+dirty is expected after build.rs itself changes; it alone is not an isolated test of the HEAD/ref watches.

Uncommitted source edits do not necessarily change HEAD/ref files. A +dirty suffix is not a unique source identity. This remains covered by the already accepted clean-build/external receipt or source digest requirement.
Hardcoded .git directory paths are not a demonstrated general solution for linked worktrees or packed-ref layouts. No general provenance overhaul required before acquisition.
Retain requested focused h=0 and metadata controls with the next relevant verification; code acceptance is based on inspection, not a new executed regression.
next: Acquire and pin genuine donor; checked runner supplies all three donor pins and complete build/input/output receipt; finish production contextual checks and real complete-state comparison. Gate 4 and capacity measurements remain open. No new speed claim.
